definition: Generalized mean-J signal versus estimated variance of the four-bank mean plus original ridge; keep eigenvalues >=4. This is a descriptive twofold signal-to-root-variance-plus-ridge rule, not a confidence bound.
noise_coordinate: Exactly zero as already implied by opposite native-noise slopes and unchanged noise constraints; use first 53 coordinates.
subspace_orthonormalization: Euclidean QR of retained generalized eigenvectors.
objective: Original three-FIT complete joint objective including all cross-coordinate terms and original ridge, restricted to retained subspace.
constraints: Original box, macro, radius .0125, current native nonincrease and fixed initial 1.01/1.10 cap with the same two existing PSD curvature corrections; additionally require each FIT predicted joint <=.99.
execution_rule: Only independently certified candidates may be considered for a separately registered native diagnostic. No model calls or training in this check.
